captions.detailed: A 3D model of a hollow cone adapter or nozzle transition piece. It features a wide, thin-walled conical base that tapers upwards into a narrow, vertical cylindrical collar. The interior of the upper collar is hollowed out and contains small, evenly spaced vertical ribs or spines running along its inner wall for structural reinforcement.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric dart cone adapter in OpenSCAD consisting of a hollowed conical base and a narrow cylindrical collar on top. The script should allow the user to adjust the cone's base radius, height, and wall thickness, as well as the collar's height, inner radius, and the number and thickness of internal reinforcing spines.
captions.factory: The model is built using two main modules: cone() and bolt_cup(). The cone() module uses a difference operation between two concentric cylinder primitives with specified start and end radii (r1 and r2) to create a hollowed frustum. The bolt_cup() module creates a hollow cylinder using a difference operation on two cylinders, and adds internal ribs using a for-loop that rotates and translates small cube primitives around the inner perimeter. The final assembly places the bolt_cup() on top of the cone() along the Z-axis using a translate transform.
